title: Cold rebuild: A pre-commit secret scanner
summary: Rebuild A pre-commit secret scanner from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **A pre-commit secret scanner** in *Worktrees, hooks, signing and large files*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Why can't you `git switch feature` in a second worktree while `feature` is checked out in the first?
options: Both worktrees would move the same branch with every commit, and one working tree would silently go stale; Git forbids it
steps.explain: Use `git switch --detach feature` there if you only need to look, or create a new branch.
